name: At least one player status note is surfaced on the match lineups
description: When a visitor opens the Lineups panel on a match page whose artifact carries an injury entry, at least one affected player surfaces a fitness status note alongside an inline warning indicator next to that player's name.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-lineups/<first-id>.json using the captured id
Read the home.injuries and away.injuries arrays and capture an affected player name if either array is non-empty
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Open the Lineups tab or scroll to the lineups region
Verify at least one player status note is rendered as visible text stating a reason and a severity, with an inline warning indicator shown next to the affected player's name in the lineup
